messages:
linh: FYI Riverbank (RB) opened RB-412 — embeddings endpoint p95 jumped from ~220ms -> ~1.2s since 06:10 UTC. They report request queueing on runtime-02 and increased retry counts. Attaching quick metrics snapshot.

incident-bot: incident INC-2025-257 created and routed to eng-runtime oncall (@owen).

owen: Looking. Can someone grab `rbctl logs runtime-02 --from 2025-11-03T06:00 --to 2025-11-03T06:30` and any tracing spans for embeddings requests?

jasper: I pulled traces for a 6:12-6:20 window. Key observations: KV cache miss rate spiked to ~87% for runtime-02, and observed a batch-size fallthrough where batch_size=1 for many requests (should be 8).

```
# sample trace tail
trace_id: 01E...a3
service: runtime-02
stage: kv_lookup latency=12ms hit=false
batcher: selected_batch_size=1
queue_time=180ms
```

maria: That lines up with the canary rollout notes — saw `kv-cache-v2` canary on runtime-02 at ~05:58 by samira. Could be a config flag that forces fallback to singletons on misses.

samira: I ran the canary to validate cache serialization changes; I did scope it to runtime-02 only. Rolling back now while we confirm.

deploy-bot: rollback initiated: canary kv-cache-v2 @runtime-02 by samira (action id: dpl-98321).

deploy-bot: rollback complete — kv-cache-v2 removed from runtime-02 (finished 06:22 UTC).

owen: After rollback p95 dropped back to ~240ms and queueing subsided. CPU/GPU utilizations normalizing.

linh: Told Riverbank we rolled back and ask them to recheck. Updated RB-412 with rollback notes and timeline.

jasper: I'll open a quick PR to add a guard: when cache serialization feature flag is on, never reduce batch target below 4 unless explicit override. Also adding a dashboard alert for sudden batch_size drop.

maria: :thumbsup: Assign PR to jasper, cc samira for context.

samira: Thanks — will add extra canary checks before scoping to a single runtime next time.

linh: Customer confirmed degraded latency gone, closing incident but leaving ticket open for follow-up on guard and canary process.

owen: Great coordination, marking this resolved on our side. Will follow up in runbook with suggested canary policy.
